items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was in Chicago, October 8th, 1958, Lem Winchester, A Tribute to Clifford Brown. If you could talk a little bit about that as a quartet recording.

ctx.x: This is from 1959. You were – as you said, you were quite prolific. In looking over your discography, I wanted to go over some of the earlier ones, a couple when you weren’t a leader. That was in Chicago, October 8th, 1958, Lem Winchester, A Tribute to Clifford Brown. If you could talk a little bit about that as a quartet recording. How did that one come about, and particularly for Clifford Brown?
